text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the spring Classics. Intense
training is
off the table for now, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby. Unable to resist
this
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, we
shoot for the
stars. And the result?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe dominates at the
Japanese
Derby! She stands tall atop the
indestructible
skyscraper!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But will her body hold out? She looks
exhausted and her footing is unstable,
but... despite it all,
she lives up to
everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's so worn out that I feel myself
aching just
looking at her. And yet,
Manhattan Cafe has
made it happen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my. And after I told you there
was no point pushing ourselves. I've
never been ignored so thoroughly. You'd
think I was completely
invisible.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll need you to go as hard with
your treatment as she went on herself.
We'll be administering supplements 3a,
8b, and 6d_2 in
that order.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll be needing three days' rest. But
given that
we've eased up on your
training, I'm sure you'll be
fine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's a little late for apologies,
don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But since you ran anyway, hold your
head up
high. I assume you've gotten
what you wanted out
of all this, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We provide Manhattan Cafe with the best
possible aftercare we can, and it
looks like we'll be able to head into the
autumn season with high
hopes.
